test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Two taps J and L can fill a tank alone in 10 minutes and 12 minutes respectively. If an outlet tap K is opened and all three taps work together, then the same tank will be filled in 15 minutes. How much time will tap K alone take to empty the same tank?
solution:
Given:

Two taps J and L can fill a tank alone in 10 minutes and 12 minutes respectively.

An outlet tap K is opened and all three taps work together, then the same tank will be filled in 15 minutes.

Concept used:

Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)

Efficiency = work done in a single day 

Calculation:

Let total work is 60 units ( LCM of 10,12 and 15) 

The efficiency of J is, 60 /10 = 6 

The efficiency of L is, 60 /12 = 5 

Combined efficiency is, 60 /15 = 4

The efficiency of K is, 6 + 5 - 4 = 7 unit

**So, K alone can empty it in 60 / 7 minutes**
